description: RFC 9116 security.txt: the RFC's examples and edge cases, evaluated at the given time (never the clock). diags lists the codes in order; valid is RFC conformance.

cases.name: RFC 9116 example
cases.text:
# Our security address
Contact: mailto:security@example.com

# Our OpenPGP key
Encryption: https://example.com/pgp-key.txt

# Our security policy
Policy: https://example.com/security-policy.html

# Our security acknowledgments page
Acknowledgments: https://example.com/hall-of-fame.html

Expires: 2021-12-31T18:37:07.000Z

cases.name: signed message framing
cases.text:
-----BEGIN PGP SIGNED MESSAGE-----
Hash: SHA256

# Canonical URI
Canonical: https://example.com/.well-known/security.txt

# Our security address
Contact: mailto:security@example.com
- Contact: https://example.com/report
Expires: 2021-12-31T18:37:07.000Z
Preferred-Languages: en, fr
-----BEGIN PGP SIGNATURE-----

iQIzBAEBCAAdFiEE
=abcd
-----END PGP SIGNATURE-----

cases.name: signature not terminated
cases.text:
-----BEGIN PGP SIGNED MESSAGE-----
Hash: SHA512

Contact: mailto:a@example.com
Expires: 2021-12-31T00:00:00Z

cases.name: content after the signature is ignored
cases.text:
-----BEGIN PGP SIGNED MESSAGE-----
Hash: SHA256

Contact: mailto:a@example.com
Expires: 2021-12-31T00:00:00Z
-----BEGIN PGP SIGNATURE-----
x
-----END PGP SIGNATURE-----
Contact: mailto:evil@example.com

cases.name: invalid expires
cases.text:
Contact: mailto:a@example.com
Expires: Fri, 31 Dec 2021 18:37:07 GMT

cases.name: expires too far is a warning
http web URIs are refused
cases.text:
Contact: http://example.com/report
Contact: mailto:a@example.com
Policy: http://example.com/p
Expires: 2021-12-31T00:00:00Z

cases.name: web-only fields need https
cases.text:
Contact: mailto:a@example.com
Canonical: mailto:a@example.com
Hiring: https://example.com/jobs
CSAF: https://example.com/.well-known/csaf/provider-metadata.json
Expires: 2021-12-31T00:00:00Z

cases.name: relative contact is not a URI
two preferred-languages fields
cases.text:
Contact: mailto:a@example.com
Preferred-Languages: en
Preferred-Languages: de
Expires: 2021-12-31T00:00:00Z

cases.name: field names are case-insensitive, unknown fields kept
cases.text:
CONTACT: mailto:a@example.com
expires: 2021-12-31T00:00:00Z
X-Custom: hello: world

cases.name: garbage line
cases.text:
Contact: mailto:a@example.com
this is not a field
Expires: 2021-12-31T00:00:00Z
